correctness.rationale: Median order chambers select exactly one of five local input coordinates, and a given input difference edge enters at most five output edge paths; piecewise affine integration proves Λ_n≤5. On the cyclic variation quotient, extreme difference vectors correspond to cyclic step indicators; their selected images are binary and have at most 2⌊n/2⌋ jumps, proving Λ_n≤⌊n/2⌋ below ten (Λ_5=0). Exact independent Fraction arithmetic reconstructs all ten published n=10..19 witnesses and five longer n=20,21,31,101,200 universal-gadget instances; each realizes ratio 5. The explicit two-interface gadget and unchanged rank selections prove all n≥20 analytically, not by extrapolating five tests.
